tasks.label: 1_data: build insurer_line_state_year.zip
tasks.detail: Rebuilds the csv from parts/ if it is missing, then writes the single-member zip that analysis.py reads.
tasks.command: test -f insurer_line_state_year.csv || (cd parts && for p in 1-200000 20-400000 40-600000 60-800000 80-1000000 100000.csv; do unzip -p "$p.zip" "$p"; done > ../insurer_line_state_year.csv) && zip -1 insurer_line_state_year.zip insurer_line_state_year.csv && unzip -l insurer_line_state_year.zip

tasks.label: venv: install requirements
tasks.detail: Creates .venv with python3.12 and installs the pinned packages.
tasks.command: python3.12 -m venv .venv && ./.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && ./.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
